commit_message: Complete governed AI Studio runtime evidence
pr_title: GameEngine: complete ADR0131 governed runtime evidence
pr_body:
## Summary

Completes the next ADR0131 first-release slice without replacing existing AgentRun, AgentEvent, permission, proposal, validation, or workspace contracts. Adds bounded persisted AgentEvent history, structured semantic/tool/playtest/frame evidence, omission of raw provider output from persisted history, safe idempotent code apply retry, and an authorized managed Editor Play/frame-capture path surfaced in AI Studio.

The change keeps semantic authoring on the project-scoped Editor MCP endpoint and does not introduce ADR0133 remote semantics or modify Dispatcher infrastructure.
